description: Signed-in only, for students and teachers. Side effect: saves a NEW private flashcard set to the person's own SpeakBase account (term and meaning per card, at most 200 characters a side), optionally starting from the cards of a public library set. It does not assign the set to any class, does not notify anyone and does not change or delete anything. Counts toward the account's set limit (free student 3 sets of up to 30 cards, free teacher 40 sets, Premium 200 new sets a month of up to 500 cards). Returns a link to review and share the set, a link to speak with Kate on these words, and for teachers a link to assign it to a class on SpeakBase.

cards.description: The person's cards. term is the word or phrase in language; definition is its meaning in explained_in.

description.description: A short description shown with the set.

explained_in.description: The language of each meaning (for example en). Can be the same as language for definitions. Taken from the library set when one is given.

from_library_set.description: Optional starting point: the library_set_id (or study link) of a public library set from get_vocabulary_set. Its cards are copied first.

keep_library_terms.description: With from_library_set: copy only the library cards with these terms. Omit to copy them all.

language.description: The language the cards teach: the language of each term (for example es). Taken from the library set when one is given.

title.description: Title of the set, for example: Kitchen words, A2.

name: create_set
title: Create a flashcard set
